correctness.rationale: The exact sum over unordered vertex pairs yields a product-polynomial mean. Its two-link expansion is verified algebraically. The full six-site choice set is compared by factored positive expressions, with one sign-changing pair difference; all hypotheses and tie boundaries are explicit. Strict discrete convexity at \(q=0\) and strict central-edge sensitivity at \(q=p\), plus finite-set continuity, establish the general \(n\ge6\) boundary regimes. A standalone checker independently computed 794 exact symbolic/rational assertions; finite sampling is not treated as proof.

broader_coverage.reasoning: Optimization algorithms on arbitrary graphs or all-or-nothing edge deletions are not by themselves theorems giving the exact optimizer for nonzero common residual q as a function of p, nor the all-\(n\) two-limit dichotomy. The \(q=0\) balanced-partition structure is consonant with graph partitioning and is not independently claimed as new; the significance lies in the strict positive-q reversal and its sharp boundary.

originality.rationale: The exact minimum six-site phase boundary and the \(n\ge6\) weak/strong attenuation structural dichotomy were not found in inspected primary sources or semantically closest publication-index records. This is qualified inspected-evidence originality, not certified priority. Primary papers address percolation models, all-or-nothing edge deletion, related firebreak risk or heuristic placement; their explicit formulations/results do not imply the claimed two partially weakened edges exact inequality. A broader hidden reliability or interdiction theorem remains a residual historical risk. A further full-text comparison with Youssef and Scoglio (2013) found time-dependent weighted-contact optimal control, not the static independent-bond path optimum. Prakash and colleagues (2013) is a related fractional node-immunization paper available only at the abstract level; that residual access risk is explicitly recorded.
residual_risks: Earlier probabilistic-network interdiction/reliability rearrangement literature could contain an equivalent exact finite-path phase boundary under other terminology.
Full exhaustive historical coverage and independent peer review have not been achieved.
No claim of general stochastic SIR equivalence for correlated edge-transmission events.

Prakash et al. (2013), Fractional Immunization in Networks, full text could not be obtained from publicly accessible source; abstract describes different node-based optimization, but whole-paper implications remain unverified.

value.rationale: The exact first network size and sharp efficacy threshold distinguish spatially separated versus adjacent controls even when all interventions have equal strength. This is a mathematically motivated qualitative phenomenon with a complete parameter classification on the minimal graph and a robust all-\(n\) limiting structural theorem, supplying a benchmark for discrete epidemic network interdiction rather than an arbitrary numeric tabulation. Generality and empirical applicability are explicitly limited.
